assumptions: Orders, their delivery station and delivery day come from the middle mile, for each staffing plan (real 2023 orders, assumed network).
Each customer is a business at one fixed point inside its station's delivery radius. The point is assumed: random but the same in every run.
A stop is every parcel for one customer on one day. A stop larger than one van is split across vans.
Vans carry 250 pairs of shoes and work a 10 hour shift. A stop takes 12 minutes plus 0.2 minutes per pair. Road distance is 1.3 times straight line distance at 35 km/h.
An owned van costs $380 a day whether or not it is used. A contracted van costs $600 on the days it is called. Every km costs $0.70. All costs are hypothetical.
A parcel carrier (like UPS Ground) is the alternative to running vans: $9 per order plus $0.90 per pair, assumed.
